_README: Example Claude Code hooks for security-preview. JSON has no comments, so the
notes live in this string array. To install: copy the 'hooks' object below
merging it with any hooks you already have. Requires 'security-preview' on
PATH -- run 'python scripts/bootstrap.py' first, then activate the venv (or
install the package globally with 'uv tool install' / 'pipx install').
SessionStart: runs a quiet high-confidence scan of the repo at session start
and feeds the summary back to Claude as context. Never blocks; a no-op when
PreToolUse (matcher 'Bash'): before any Bash command, if the command is a
'git commit', run 'security-preview scan . --format json' and compare the
CRITICAL count against the baseline in '.security-preview/baseline-critical'
(a single integer; treated as 0 when the file is absent). Exit code 2 blocks
the commit and shows the message to Claude when the count has grown. To adopt
the current CRITICAL count as the accepted baseline:

hooks.command:
python -c "import shutil,subprocess,sys
if not shutil.which('security-preview'):
    sys.exit(0)
p=subprocess.run(['security-preview','scan','.','--format','text','--min-confidence','high'],capture_output=True,text=True)
sys.stdout.write(p.stdout)
sys.exit(0)"

python -c "import json,os,subprocess,sys
data=json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd=(data.get('tool_input') or {}).get('command','')
if 'git commit' not in cmd:
    sys.exit(0)
if not __import__('shutil').which('security-preview'):
    print('security-preview not installed; skipping commit gate', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(0)
proc=subprocess.run(['security-preview','scan','.','--format','json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
try:
    result=json.loads(proc.stdout)
except ValueError:
    print('security-preview: could not parse scan output; allowing commit', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(0)
crit=result.get('summary',{}).get('by_severity',{}).get('CRITICAL',0)
path=os.path.join('.security-preview','baseline-critical')
baseline=0
if os.path.exists(path):
    baseline=int((open(path).read().strip() or '0'))
if crit>baseline:
    print('security-preview: blocking commit -- %d CRITICAL finding(s), baseline %d. Fix them (security-preview scan . --format markdown) or update %s.' % (crit, baseline, path), file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
sys.exit(0)"
